title: Looking for architectural feedback on a crypto trading platform
author: Relevant-Brother-516
selftext:
Hi everyone,

Over the past several months I've been building a crypto trading platform and I'd really appreciate feedback from developers who have experience with trading systems, fintech products, or high-performance web applications.

The platform currently includes:

* Spot & Futures trading
* Live market data
* Multi-wallet architecture
* Portfolio management
* Transaction history
* Open positions
* Referral system
* Admin dashboard
* React / Next.js frontend
* Supabase + PostgreSQL backend

My main goal with this post is to get honest architectural feedback before taking the platform further.

Some questions I'd love your opinion on:

* Which parts of the architecture would you redesign?
* What scalability improvements would you prioritize?
* Are there any technologies or services you think would better fit this type of platform?
* If you were continuing development, what would be your next priorities?

I'd also like to ask something else.

If Reddit isn't the right place for discussions about acquiring software projects like this, I'd really appreciate recommendations on where people usually buy and sell established crypto/fintech platforms or software assets.

And if anyone here is currently looking to acquire an existing crypto trading platform or believes this project could fit their business, don't hesitate to send me a private message. I'd be happy to discuss it and answer any technical questions.

I appreciate any feedback or recommendations.
